question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **ambiguity**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Ambiguity**: The quality of being open to more than one interpretation; inexactness.
 
• **Sneak**: Move or go in a furtive or stealthy way.
 
• **Wanderlust**: A strong desire to travel.
 
• **Purpose**: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Exams are worrisome for everyone, whether students or professionals because everyone wants to do well and no one wants to fail in order to prevent uncertainty in the future.
 
• So, "**ambiguity**" is the correct word choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *Academic life has (1) become __demanding for students as a result of different internal and external expectations. Teenagers are especially __(2) prone__ to academic stress because they go through so many personal and social changes. As a result, designing effective and efficient __(3) intervention__ solutions requires a thorough understanding of the causes and consequences of academic stress. Exams are one of the __(4) most crucial __aspects__ __of anyone's life. Exams are stressful for everyone, whether they are students or adults because everyone wants to perform well and no one wants to fail as to avoid **__(5) ambiguity__** in future.*
